title: Time authorities, tracker, and LinkLayer receipts can use incompatible monotonic domains
description: Post-fix correctness review: TimeProvider, LinkLayer receipt clock, DioTimeVerifier, and StratumTracker may use unrelated monotonic clocks/origins; tracker snapshots identities but never enforces one shared domain. Offset clocks cause false future/stale rejection and wrong projection/expiry. Bind all evidence and receipt timestamps to one explicit monotonic clock capability/domain, reject mismatches at construction, and test offset-domain rejection plus shared-domain success.
